imports: Python standard library and numpy only; no repository analysis/evaluator/solver imports.

definitions.mask: Both rows observed, all x/v/Z components finite, lifecycle active, and explicitly precontact_eligible.
definitions.RMS: sqrt(mean(Euclidean vector difference squared)) or scalar absolute Z; equal weight per retained ID/time row.
definitions.denominator: Actual explicit 287 IDs x 121 saved clock, including missing or terminal rows.
definitions.missing: No fill, interpolation, padding or substitute state.
definitions.native_disappeared: Kept distinct from candidate escaped; no inferred boundary cause.

normalized_csv.meaning: Explicit normalized keys are not proof of observed coordinate states.

common_three_level_self_sensitivity.step_ratio_basis: Declared twofold ratios in the bound saved summary; CSV states alone do not authenticate actual integration partitions.
